_conforms_to.spec: harness-unique fault context schema. Payload shape approximates O2 IMS Infrastructure Monitoring alarm notifications and O-RAN.WG6 Cloud Notifications.
_conforms_to.spec_section: O2ims_InfrastructureMonitoring AlarmEventRecord data type (O2IMS-INTERFACE R005-v11 Section 3.3.6.2.2, bibliography ref 3) and AlarmChangeNotification (Section 3.3.5.1.2, ref 3). Also informed by O-Cloud Alarms framework (Section 4, ref 3) and WG6 Cloud Notifications payload contract (ref 31).
_conforms_to.spec_version: WG6 O2IMS-INTERFACE R005-v11, WG6 Cloud Notifications current

title: FaultPayload
description: Synthetic platform-agent evidence bundle published as a CloudEvent upstream of the Agent Harness. Each scenario's fault_payload.json validates against this schema.

node.description: Fully qualified hostname of the affected worker node.

tool_name.description: MCP tool name in dotted notation, e.g. mcp-platform.get_ptp4l_status.

finding.description: Human-readable summary of what the agent observed.

raw_data.description: Tool-specific structured data backing the finding.

taxonomy_match.description: Must match a taxonomy id from harness/taxonomy.yaml.
